extracted.name: Mojo Grilling Marinade
extracted.description: This mojo marinade, packed with garlic, orange and lime juice, herbs, and spices, is a great way to infuse flavor into pork or fish before grilling.
instruction_lines: Pulse garlic and onion in a blender until very finely chopped.
Add orange juice, lime juice, cilantro, salt, oregano, hot pepper sauce, cumin, lemon pepper, and black pepper. Blend until thoroughly incorporated.
Pour in olive oil; blend until smooth.
